subject: Final authorization: paperflow, signature windows, and commencement for Solace Health MAP
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final authorization: paperflow, signature windows, and commencement for Solace Health MAP

Team —

Attached are the final MAP + SLA (Final-MAP-SLA-v3.docx) and the signature routing workbook (Signature-Roadmap.xlsx). Per last week's exec review, Solace will need:

- formal customer sign-off on performance milestones (eval plan)
- procurement PO + billing contact confirmed
- signed SOW/Agreement with a start-of-service date locked

I want to be explicit about the approval cadence so we don't lose the current slot in our infra calendar:

1) Sales/CS confirmation: we get the customer OK on the MAP and the chosen launch date by EOD Wednesday (05/12).
2) Legal: k-approval on the redlines — I asked legal to pre-clear the 45-day data retention clause; flag if anything else pops up.
3) Procurement: PO and billing contact must arrive before DocuSign is routed (procurement typically needs 48 hours for PO issuance).
4) Signatures: proposing three discrete signing windows next week (Tue AM, Wed PM, Thu AM). We should pick a primary and two backups.
5) Commencement: the target start date is 05/24/2027 (customer requested); ops needs 7 business days post-signature for infra reservation and warmup.

Please review the attached and confirm which signing window we should request and whether the start date of 05/24 is acceptable given the PO timing. I'll kick off the DocuSign envelope once we lock the primary slot.

Thanks —
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: Final-MAP-SLA-v3.docx (docx, 1.2 MB), Signature-Roadmap.xlsx (xlsx, 120 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final authorization: paperflow, signature windows, and commencement for Solace Health MAP

Neha —

Thanks for the draft. Quick notes inline.

> 1) Sales/CS confirmation: we get the customer OK on the MAP and the chosen launch date by EOD Wednesday (05/12).

That's fine, but ask CS to confirm the evaluation completion checklist (we need raw latency/throughput samples for a 48-hour window). If they don't have that, ops will push the start date by one week.

> 2) Legal: k-approval on the redlines — I asked legal to pre-clear the 45-day data retention clause; flag if anything else pops up.

Legal flagged two minor items in SOW_Solace_vFinal.pdf: the indemnity cap formatting (we proposed a cap at 3x fees) and an SLA uptime measurement clarifier. Both are standard; they said we can accept as-is if procurement signs off on PO terms.

> 4) Signatures: proposing three discrete signing windows next week (Tue AM, Wed PM, Thu AM). We should pick a primary and two backups.

Primary: Tue 10:00–10:30 PT (allows DocuSign routing same-day). Backup: Wed 16:00–16:30 PT. Third: Thu 09:00–09:30 PT.

I'll make a note in Signature-Roadmap.xlsx for routing order and the required internal approvers. Also, add a column for the bill-to entity name the customer will put on the PO — that's been a source of delay in the past.

Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Final authorization: paperflow, signature windows, and commencement for Solace Health MAP

Neha / team —

Thanks for putting this together. We're aligned on the MAP and the eval plan; our internal trial finished yesterday and the metrics are within the agreed thresholds. Few operational notes from procurement:

- Procurement needs the final SOW (SOW_Solace_vFinal.pdf) attached to the DocuSign envelope and a quote line that matches their vendor portal.
- They will issue a PO — estimated time to PO issuance is 48–72 hours after the final SOW is uploaded.
- For signings, our CFO prefers Wed afternoon but can make Tue morning if necessary.

Proposed: ask us for Wed 16:00 PT as primary (matches CFO availability); Tue 10:00 is an acceptable fallback. If Wed works for Redwood, we'll aim to have the PO into you by Thursday EOD.

Also, can you confirm the start-of-service maintenance window? We prefer a weekday activation (Mon or Tue) to ensure our SREs are on call.

Tom Sanders
VP Product, Solace Health
tom.sanders@solacehealth.com

Tom / Ayesha —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround and the trial run results. We can do Wed 16:00 PT as the primary signing slot. Action items and timing: 

- Today/tonight: I'll upload the final SOW to the DocuSign envelope and tag procurement as required signer (SOW_Solace_vFinal.pdf).
- Tue: procurement issues PO (expected 48 hours). Please update the bill-to name in the HubSpot record if it differs from the legal entity.
- Wed 16:00 PT: primary signature window (DocuSign routing to CFO -> Legal -> Emerson (Solace ops) -> Redwood exec). Envelope link: https://redwood.app/docusign/RWF-1427
- Thu (05/20): ops warm-up and final smoke tests. We will reserve the infra pool starting Wed night.
- Target commencement: Mon 05/24/2027 at 09:00 PT — ops will confirm on Friday that warm-up completed.

If procurement can't meet the PO timing, we will move the start date to Mon 05/31 to allow proper billing setup. Please confirm PO ETA and the bill-to entity by EOD Tue.

Neha
